title: Counter with a floor
prompt: Implement nested class `Solution.Counter`: starts at 0; `Increment()` adds 1; `Decrement()` subtracts 1 but the value **never goes below 0**; read-only `Value` property.

tests.name: normal
tests.hint: A fresh counter is zero; the value tracks the exact operation sequence.

tests.name: floor
tests.hint: The floor is the contract: decrementing at zero must be a no-op, not a hidden negative.
